item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The verse grammar supports Punjabi, so I updated the language metadata to `Panjabi` / `pa-Arab` / `rtl` and removed the missing-source tag. I checked that both versions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Only the selected lyric was edited.

I read Roman *rizawaan* as `رضاواں` and *kitay* as `کِتّے`, meaning “for.”
